messages:
Joanne C: Hey team — quick first-week check: ADP shows my medical effective 2025-05-01 but my offer says 2025-05-15. Which is correct? Also need to add my spouse as a dependent — where do I upload proof? My company card (Ramp) still says 'pending activation'. When should I expect my first paycheck, and are holidays prorated if you start mid-month? Thanks!

Marta (People Ops): Congrats and welcome, Joanne! :tada: We'll verify the effective date. For dependent docs, upload to the Benefits portal (link below) or reply here and we can intake manually. Card activations are usually automatic within 24-48h of provisioning — do you see an activation email from Ramp?

James (Payroll): Hi Joanne — FYI Payroll cycle: we run payroll every other Friday. If your official start date in Workday/ADP is 2025-05-15, your first paycheck should be on the next scheduled payday after that and will show prorated earnings. The paystub will show 'Prorated Salary' lines.

Marta (People Ops): To be explicit: the benefit effective date is governed by the 'benefit eligibility date' on your HR record, not the offer letter text if there was a mismatch. I'm pulling your record now. Please upload dependent proof as one of: PDF, JPG, PNG (<= 5MB) to https://benefits.redwood.com/upload or email benefits@redwood.com with subject 'Dependent Docs - Joanne C'

Benefits Bot: Hi Joanne — automated note: dependent documents accepted: birth certificate, marriage certificate, domestic partner affidavit, or proof of insurance listing both names. Accepted formats PDF/JPG/PNG. Max file size 5MB. Expected review time: 3-5 business days.

Marta (People Ops): @James looping you in to confirm payroll date and to check if the ADP record shows 5/01 or 5/15 as Joanne's eligibility. Also, Joanne — for card issues: open the Ramp app and check the last 4 digits; if still pending, ping ramp-support@redwood.com and cc me.

James (Payroll): Checked — HR record shows benefit eligibility = 2025-05-15. ADP/benefits will be updated to 5/15; medical should align to 5/15. Payroll note: if you had any hours before 5/15 (contractor/contract overlap) that can change dates — are there any overlapping entries?

Joanne C: No overlap — my official start date is 5/15. I'll upload my marriage certificate tonight to the portal. I did get an email from Ramp but the activation link expired — I'll email ramp-support now and cc Marta.

Marta (People Ops): Perfect — once we get the dependent upload we'll kick off verification. For holiday proration: company holidays are pro-rated for new hires who start mid-pay-period per HR policy — you get credit for company-observed holidays that occur after your start date in that accrual period. If you want the exact math for May once payroll posts, James can provide the number.

James (Payroll): Yep — send me a DM if you want a quick calc once the payroll run posts. Also, make sure your W-4/state tax forms are uploaded in ADP — otherwise default withholding applies.

Joanne C: Thanks everyone — uploading docs now. Quick follow-up: moving expense reimbursement — is that submitted through Ramp expenses or People Ops?

Marta (People Ops): Moving reimbursement goes through our expense portal (Ramp expenses) with the 'Relocation' category. We require receipts + the signed relocation acknowledgment form. I can DM you the template and link.

Joanne C: Awesome, appreciate it. :heart:

Marta (People Ops): One last note — once dependent verification completes we will confirm insurance card shipment or electronic card activation. Expect a confirmation thread/email from benefits@redwood.com. Ping here if anything still looks off.

Joanne C: Will do — thanks again!
